title: feat(console): org join-link UI — manage/copy dialog on the Team surface + /join/:token self-serve landing route
body:
Part of objectstack-ai/objectstack#11586 (epic — ruling and V1 scope live there).
Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectstack#11587

## Deliverable (console UI half of the universal org join link)

1. **Link management dialog** on the org Team surface (the `sys_organization` record page toolbar and/or the platform org console's Members/Invitations pages — pick the entry that coexists with the just-landed `invite_user` toolbar mirror, objectstack#11544): owner/admin-only "Invite via link" — shows the active link (full URL), Copy, Rotate (with confirm — old link dies), Revoke, expiry display. No active link ⇒ Create.
2. **`/join/:token` console route**: fetch token info (org display name + validity). Unauthenticated ⇒ login/signup with return-to back to the join page. Authenticated ⇒ confirmation ("Join <org>?") → POST join → set active organization → land in the org shell. Distinct UI states for expired / revoked / exhausted / invalid / already-a-member (the backend card publishes the error codes in its PR body).
3. i18n: en / zh-CN / ja-JP / es-ES for all new strings (follow the console's existing org-surface i18n patterns; aria-labels included — see the objectui#8094 class).

## Constraints
- URL shape mirrors the existing invitation route family (`/_console/accept-invitation/<id>` ⇒ `/_console/join/<token>`); build URLs through the same single-source console-URL helper the accept-invitation flow uses.
- The link is a bearer credential: never log it, never put it in analytics payloads.
- Do not start until the Blocked-by lands: endpoint paths + error codes come from that PR's body.
